proves.claim: clause 1: unmetWaits returns no unmet wait for an id in item.afterGate whose item is submitted with gateGreen true, so dependenciesVerified holds; the same parent submitted without gateGreen, or open, is still returned as unmet.

moves.lifecycle-rules.after-gate-parent-.why: A parent whose gate is green already proves its work, so a child waiting only on the gate should not sit blocked until the parent is verified (#11803).

proves.claim: clause 2: an id in item.after that is not in item.afterGate still needs status verified, even when that item is submitted with gateGreen true; with afterGate and gateGreen absent the result equals today's.

moves.lifecycle-rules.after-gate-only-fo.why: Only the waits a coordinator names as after-gate relax; every other wait keeps the verified rule (#11803).
